_notes: ADD-PARK GUIDE: to support a new park/event, copy this file and fill in the fields.
No code changes needed — the app loads whichever config is selected.
House 'zone' and 'map' coordinates are APPROXIMATE (author-estimated from public park maps, Oct 2026).
They exist only to estimate walk times between stops. Edit freely; the optimizer reads them live.
'demand' tiers and 'typicalWaitMin/typicalWaitMax' are ESTIMATES based on published house rankings
(AllEars HHN35 ranking, TouringPlans impressions) and IP vs original-house crowd patterns — not measured data.
Event hours vary by night; the value below is a typical evening. Verify on Universal's site before your visit.
